note: Korean café night: aspirated ㅊㅋㅌㅍ (puff of air) vs tense ㄲㄸㅃㅆㅉ (tight, no air) — real goal: read a Seoul café menu (커피, 차). Warm-up さ/た rows first. 写三遍，念出声。

tasks.title: How to Study Korean · Unit 0 Lesson 1 · skim the ㅊㅋㅌㅍ and double-consonant parts
Read aloud: plain vs aspirated vs tense

lines.translation: Dad's coffee is cheap · 爸爸的咖啡便宜

tasks.prompt: Hold a tissue in front of your mouth: ㅋㅌㅍㅊ should make it move, ㄲㄸㅃㅉ should not. Say 가/카/까, 다/타/따, 바/파/빠, 자/차/짜 ×3. Write 바다 and 나무 ×3 (Tuesday's misses), then 커피 차 포도 once each. Last, explain in one breath the difference between ㅋ and ㄲ: point, reason, example.
tasks.script: Rows: 가 카 까 (ga ka kka), 다 타 따 (da ta tta), 바 파 빠 (ba pa ppa), 자 차 짜 (ja cha jja) — tissue moves on the middle one only. Writing: 바다 바다 바다 (bada, sea), 나무 나무 나무 (namu, tree), 커피 차 포도. Explanation: "ㅋ is aspirated and ㄲ is tense. ㅋ comes with a puff of air, while ㄲ is tight with no air. For example, 카 has a puff and 까 doesn't."

questions.q: Which one has a puff of air?
questions.explain: ㅋ = aspirated k (puff). ㄲ = tense kk (no air), ㄱ = plain g/k.
ㅋ k + ㅓ eo = 커, ㅍ p + ㅣ i = 피 → keopi, coffee.
Double ㅅ = tense ss, as in 싸다 ssada (cheap).
짜다 jjada = salty. Cheap = 싸다, tea = 차.
ㅂ+ㅏ = 바, ㄷ+ㅏ = 다. You missed this Tuesday; ㅂ is the bucket.
ㄹ between vowels is a light r flap: uri.
차 cha (aspirated) = tea/car. 자 ja is plain, 짜 jja is tense.
ち = chi (た row). さ = sa, き = ki.
